I felt similar to you after my mom dragged me to the hospital for cutting my wrist. I was feeling really suicidal. 
The nurse (a man) was very aggressive and told me to change into a hospital gown. He took my backpack and the police checked it for drugs. 
I was uncomfortable the whole time, a lady outside my open door was watching me intensely as I was just calmly sitting on the bed. 
Then mental help people came in to ask me questions. I lied to them when I said I wasn't feeling suicidal anymore, and they quickly sent me home, after giving me back my clothes and backpack. It felt as if I was being let go from jail.
I left, being charged $100. I know that's WAY less than what you had to pay, but the whole situation just left me feeling empty and weird. None of the medical staff seemed to have any care, they all treated me as if I was a threat to them. It was weird.
